{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders with revenue = 999999.99")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Found {len(refunded_orders)} refunded orders")

# Check unique channels
channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f"Unique channels: {channels}")

# Check if revenue is actually numeric after removing commas
# First, strip commas and convert to float
# But first, check if there are any non-numeric values

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'].str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')

# Count how many were converted successfully
converted_count = df['revenue_clean'].notna().sum()
print(f"Number of revenue values successfully converted: {converted_count} out of {len(df)}")

# Check for any remaining non-numeric entries
non_numeric = df[df['revenue_clean'].isna()]
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {len(non_numeric)}")

# Display first few rows of cleaned revenue
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())"}
